_meta.description: Question bank for the live demo. 10 fixed skill positions, 3 parallel sets (A/B/C). A session picks ONE set at random but the skill at each position is IDENTICAL across all three sets -- this preserves the skill sequence the model expects while varying the actual question content session to session.
_meta.raw_skill_id: the ORIGINAL ASSISTments skill_id -- this is what must be passed to the FastAPI service, which re-indexes it internally via skill_map. Do NOT pass internal_skill_id to the API.
_meta.internal_skill_id: included for reference only -- confirms this skill exists in the trained model's skill_map. Not needed by the frontend or API caller.
_meta.answer_checking: All answers are numeric or short exact-match strings. Compare trimmed, case-insensitive string equality, or numeric equality with tolerance 0.01 for decimal answers.

skill_sequence.skill_name: Solving Systems of Linear Equations by Graphing

A.question_text: A jacket costs $60. It is on sale for 15% off. What is the sale price?
A car travels 150 miles in 3 hours. What is its rate in miles per hour?
Solve the system: x + y = 10, x - y = 2. What is x?
The lines y = x + 1 and y = -x + 5 intersect at what x-value?
A right triangle has legs of length 3 and 4. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

B.question_text: A shirt costs $45. It is on sale for 20% off. What is the sale price?
A runner covers 12 miles in 2 hours. What is their rate in miles per hour?
Solve the system: x + y = 12, x - y = 4. What is x?
The lines y = 2x and y = -x + 6 intersect at what x-value?
A right triangle has legs of length 6 and 8. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

C.question_text: A pair of shoes costs $80. It is on sale for 25% off. What is the sale price?
A cyclist travels 40 miles in 4 hours. What is their rate in miles per hour?
Solve the system: x + y = 8, x - y = 2. What is x?
The lines y = x - 1 and y = -x + 3 intersect at what x-value?
A right triangle has legs of length 5 and 12. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

D.question_text: A backpack costs $100. It is on sale for 30% off. What is the sale price?
A train travels 100 miles in 5 hours. What is its rate in miles per hour?
Solve the system: x + y = 14, x - y = 6. What is x?
The lines y = x + 2 and y = -2x + 11 intersect at what x-value?
A right triangle has legs of length 9 and 12. What is the length of the hypotenuse?

E.question_text: A jacket costs $50. It is on sale for 40% off. What is the sale price?
A car travels 200 miles in 4 hours. What is its rate in miles per hour?
Solve the system: x + y = 20, x - y = 8. What is x?
The lines y = x + 4 and y = -x + 10 intersect at what x-value?
A right triangle has legs of length 8 and 15. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
